row:
PhysioU builds top-rated physical therapy educational web app to simplify and bridge the gap between research and expert clinical practice.

A collection of innovative, simple to use, evidence-based web apps, developed to help healthcare students and clinicians organize and access the overwhelming amounts of information regarding diagnosing, assessing, movement faults, and treatments.

It is a digital pocket-size medical guide that you can use in either the classroom, in the clinic, at home or on the go.
